title: Who Is Like the Lord Our God?

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Praise, O servants of the Lord, praise the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:1 (ESV): "Praise, O servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord!"

questions.question: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:2 (ESV): "Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and forevermore!"

questions.question: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the Lord is to be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:3 (ESV): "From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the Lord is to be praised!"

questions.question: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:4 (ESV): "The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens!"

questions.question: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:5 (ESV): "Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,"

questions.question: Who looks far down on the heavens and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:6 (ESV): "who looks far down on the heavens and the earth?"

questions.question: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:7 (ESV): "He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,"

questions.question: To make them sit with princes, with the princes of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:8 (ESV): "to make them sit with princes, with the princes of his people."

questions.question: He gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyous mother of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:9 (ESV): "He gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyous mother of children."

questions.question: This Psalm is part of which collection of Psalms used during Passover?
What does the Lord do for the poor?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:7 (ESV): "He raises the poor from the dust..."

questions.question: When is the name of the Lord to be praised?
options: From the rising of the sun to its setting
questions.correctAnswer: From the rising of the sun to its setting

questions.question: Where is the Lord's glory?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:4 (ESV): "...and his glory above the heavens!"

questions.question: Who are called to praise the Lord in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:1 (ESV): "Praise, O servants of the Lord..."

questions.question: With whom does God make the poor sit?
questions.explanation: Psalm 113:8 (ESV): "to make them sit with princes..."

key_verse_text: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high, who looks far down on the heavens and the earth?
